field.label: Enable DPI-SSL
field.help: Let the firewall decrypt HTTPS so that downloads can be scanned and content rules can be applied. Needs the privacy notice (AI Audit > Privacy) and the certificate installed on every device.

field.label: What to decrypt
field.help: "Only the sites listed" is the safe choice. "All HTTPS" decrypts every connection except the exclusions and needs a full certificate.

field.label: Sites to decrypt
field.help: Used when you decrypt only the sites listed. A site includes its sub-domains. AI services and the download sites of Antivirus are added automatically.

field.label: Never decrypt these sites
field.help: Banks, health services and anything that must stay private. A site includes its sub-domains.

field.label: Also skip well-known pinned sites
field.help: Operating system updates, messengers and similar services reject decrypted connections. This ready-made list keeps them working.

field.label: Certificate type
field.help: The type the next new certificate is created with. A restricted certificate can only sign the sites above, so a stolen key is much less dangerous.
